mapper.select:
SET @genYear = #{year}; SET @genMonth = #{month};
SELECT cssc.FACTORY_CODE, @genYear AS `YEAR`, @genMonth AS `MONTH`, cssc.STRUCTURE_NAME, cssc.TURNOVER_MONTH, cssc.MIN_VULCANIZING_MACHINE FROM T_DP_CYCLE_SCH_STRU_CONF cssc WHERE cssc.IS_DELETE = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL a WHERE a.IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY a.FACTORY_CODE, a.STRUCTURE_NAME HAVING a.FACTORY_CODE = cssc.FACTORY_CODE AND a.STRUCTURE_NAME = cssc.STRUCTURE_NAME AND MAX(a.`YEAR_MONTH`) <= DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(CONCAT(@genYear, '-', @genMonth, '-01'), INTERVAL cssc.TURNOVER_MONTH MONTH), '%Y%m'))
